description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: John Bates caught two of his three targets for 13 yards in the Commanders' 24-22 loss to the Philadelphia Eagles in Week 1.
items.impact: Bates saw minimal involvement in a disappointing Washington passing attack, averaging just 6.5 yards per catch in the loss. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats, with a Week 2 divisional contest against the Dallas Cowboys up next.
items.title: John Bates catches two passes in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jalen Hurts completed 14-of-25 pass attempts for 203 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing seven times for 46 yards in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Hurts made the most of an inconsistent season-opening performance behind center, averaging 14.5 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with more explosive dual-threat production in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.
items.title: Jalen Hurts tosses three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Saquon Barkley carried the ball 15 times for 83 yards while also catching one of his two targets for a loss of three yards in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Barkley made the most of what the Washington defense gave him, averaging 5.5 yards per carry in the win. The running back will look to offer fantasy managers a dynamic RB1 option in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.
items.title: Saquon Barkley leads backfield attack in Week 1 win over Commanders

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks hauled in two of his four targets for 73 yards and one touchdown in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Wicks made the most of his modest target share in the season opener, averaging 36.5 yards per reception in the win. The wideout offers head coach Nick Sirianni another explosive pass-catching option moving forward, with a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans up next.
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks finds end zone in Week 1 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Dallas Goedert hauled in four of his five targets for 77 yards and two touchdowns in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Goedert made the most of his involvement in the Philadelphia passing attack in the season opener, leading the team in receiving yards in the win. The tight end offers fantasy managers a steady TE1 option entering a favorable Week 2 contest against the Tennessee Titans.
items.title: Dallas Goedert hauls in two touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: DeVonta Smith caught three of his six targets for 53 yards in the Eagles' 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: The wideout was mostly held in check despite leading the team in targets, finishing behind tight end Dallas Goedert and No. 2 wideout Dontayvion Wicks in receiving yards on the win. The wideout remains one of the more explosive options in the Philadelphia passing attack, with an opportunity to get back on track against the Tennessee Titans in Week 2 up next.
items.title: DeVonta Smith catches three passes in Week 1 win

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers hosted WR Nick Nash for a workout.
items.impact: Nash will compete to earn a depth role on the practice squad for Green Bay.
items.title: Nick Nash works out for Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets worked out WR JuJu Smith-Schuster.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster was released by the Giants before the start of the season.
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster works out for Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days.
items.impact: Lane could undergo surgery as early as Wednesday. They are hopeful he'll only miss about one month.
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) expected to undergo surgery, miss one month

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Makai Lemon caught three of his four targets for a loss of five yards on the Eagles' 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
items.impact: Lemon struggled to find any success in the season opener, as the pass-catcher was bottled up by the Commanders defense in the win. The wideout will look for more impactful output in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.
items.title: Makai Lemon quiet in Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed WR Lil'Jordan Humphrey to their active roster.
items.impact: Humphrey will add depth in the wide receiver room for Denver.
items.title: Lil'Jordan Humphrey signs with Broncos

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Tank Bigsby rushed one time for three yards in the Eagles' 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
items.impact: Bigsby was more of an afterthought in the Philadelphia ground attack, finishing last on the team in carries. The running back remains more of a handcuff option for No. 1 running back Saquon Barkley ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Tennessee Titans.
items.title: Tank Bigsby sees one touch in Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed CB Johnathan Edwards to the practice squad.
items.impact: Edwards will add depth in the secondary for Indianapolis.
items.title: Johnathan Edwards signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans hosted free agent LB Kenneth Murray Jr. for a visit on Tuesday.
items.impact: Murray formerly spent time with the Chargers, Titans and Cowboys.
items.title: Kenneth Murray Jr. visits Texans

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Will Shipley rushed twice for four yards while also catching his only target for eight yards in the Eagles' 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
items.impact: Shipley saw minimal involvement out of the backfield, with No. 1 running back Saquon Barkley out-touching him 16-3 in the win. The running back can remain off rosters until further notice, with a Week 2 contest against the Tennessee Titans up next.
items.title: Will Shipley sees three touches in Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars signed OLB BJ Ojulari.
items.impact: Ojulari was formerly with the Cardinals. He lands a fresh start just at 24 years old.
items.title: BJ Ojulari signs with Jaguars

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers hosted OT Austin Deculus for a workout.
items.impact: Deculus was one of two offensive tackles hosted by Pittsburgh on Tuesday.
items.title: Austin Deculus works out for Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers hosted OT Charlie Heck for a workout.
items.impact: Heck was one of two offensive tackles hosted by Pittsburgh on Tuesday.
items.title: Charlie Heck works out for Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers waived WR Jimmy Horn Jr.
items.impact: Horn did not see one target in Week 1. He will look to land a fresh start with another team.
items.title: Jimmy Horn Jr. waived by Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens released K Jake Moody from their practice squad.
items.impact: Moody will look to compete with another team.
items.title: Jake Moody released by Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. was limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Reed was added to the injury report on Tuesday. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday ahead of Thursday's game against the Bills.
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (foot) limited in practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets signed WR Tyler Johnson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson will add depth in the wide receiver room with Omar Cooper week-to-week.
items.title: Tyler Johnson signs with Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ty Johnson was limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Johnson was also listed as limited on Monday. He remains up in the air for Thursday's short week game against the Lions.
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited in practice Tuesday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: The Eagles D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
items.impact: The unit left plenty to be desired in the season-opening win, allowing 296 offensive yards and three touchdowns on the day. The defense will look for more disruptive results for fantasy managers against an underwhelming Tennessee Titans offense in Week 2.
items.title: Eagles D/ST registers one sack in Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers placed WR KeAndre Lambert-Smith on injured reserve.
items.impact: Lambert-Smith suffered the injury in the season opener. He will miss at least the next four games.
items.title: KeAndre Lambert-Smith placed on IR
